title: Teaching flag canonicalized: **safe_to_auto_adopt:** snake_case everywhere
description: The safe_to_auto_adopt flag had 4 format variants across 30 hub teachings, causing wakeup grep (case-sensitive snake_case) to silently miss ~12 valid flags. Root cause: template used Title Case hyphenated format, protocol grepped snake_case. Fixed by: (1) standardizing template and all hub teachings to **safe_to_auto_adopt:** true/false, (2) updating wai.md Step 5 to use case-insensitive grep and define missing-flag fallback as false (require manual review).
rationale: Teaching recipients were confused because wakeup presented some teachings as auto-adopt and others as ambiguous. Protocol and template were out of sync from the start.
